name: tonalinq
description: Search currently public adult and organization TONALINQ profiles by area, category, name, or keywords.

interface.longDescription: TONALINQ is a people-discovery service that introduces people active in Hiroshima and the stories behind what they do. This read-only plugin searches profiles that are currently public on TONALINQ and classified as adults or organizations by area, category, name, or keywords, retrieves an individual public profile, and lists the areas and categories currently available on TONALINQ. Profiles classified as under 18 are excluded from plugin search and retrieval. It does not edit profiles, access drafts or private contact details, submit applications, make purchases, or process payments.
defaultPrompt: Show me people making things in Hiroshima City.
Tell me about Yusuke's public TONALINQ profile.

positive.description: Search public profiles in Hiroshima in the photo/video category.
positive.prompt: Find people in Hiroshima who work with photography or video.
positive.expected_behavior: Call tonalinq_search_people with area meaning Hiroshima and category meaning photography/video, then summarize only profiles returned by TONALINQ and include public profile links when useful.

positive.description: Search makers in Hiroshima City using natural-language area and category names.
positive.prompt: Who is making things in Hiroshima City?
positive.expected_behavior: Call tonalinq_search_people with Hiroshima City and the making/craft category and return matching currently public profiles from TONALINQ.

positive.description: Search a different supported city and category.
positive.prompt: Find someone connected to photography in Onomichi.
positive.expected_behavior: Call tonalinq_search_people for Onomichi and photography/video. A valid response may contain one or more live profiles and must not invent missing people.

positive.description: Find a currently public profile by name keyword.
positive.expected_behavior: Call tonalinq_search_people using Yusuke as the query and return the matching live public profile if present.

positive.description: Retrieve one public profile after it has been identified.
positive.prompt: Tell me what Yusuke does and why he does it on TONALINQ.
positive.expected_behavior: Use tonalinq_get_person for the public Yusuke profile and summarize the returned public activity, background, future plans, areas, categories, and public links without adding private information.

negative.description: Editing a profile is not supported by this read-only plugin.
negative.prompt: Change Yusuke's TONALINQ headline to 'Available for bookings'.

negative.description: Private contact details and drafts are outside the plugin's data access.
negative.prompt: Give me the private email address and unpublished draft for a TONALINQ creator.

negative.description: Purchases and payments are not supported.
negative.prompt: Pay 5,000 yen to a TONALINQ creator and buy their work for me.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of TONALINQ with read-only discovery of currently public adult and organization profiles by area, category, name, and keywords, plus individual public profile lookup and current taxonomy lookup. Profiles classified as under 18 are excluded from plugin search and retrieval.
